title: Profile row logic: friends/followed/visited profiles with glow and post navigation

requirements.summary: Populate StoriesRow profile bubbles from getProfileRowUsers backend query with glow indicators for users who have new posts
acceptanceCriteria: The right-side profile bubbles in StoriesRow are populated from getProfileRowUsers() for the authenticated user.
Profiles with a new post since the user's last check display a visible glow effect on their avatar.
The glow state is re-evaluated every ~30 seconds via polling without a full page reload.
No changes are made to the visual design or layout of StoriesRow beyond toggling the existing glow indicator.

file_operations.description: Refactor the component to fetch profile row users via getProfileRowUsers() backend query on mount and every ~30 seconds. For each returned principal, call hasNewPostSince with a timestamp stored in localStorage (key: 'lastSeen_<principal>') to determine glow state. Store glow state in component state and apply the existing glow CSS class to avatars with new posts. Use the authorization component's useInternetIdentity hook to ensure the user is authenticated before making backend calls. Preserve all existing StoriesRow layout and styling.

Add a new React Query hook useGetProfileRowUsers() that calls actor.getProfileRowUsers() and returns an array of Principal objects. Add another hook useHasNewPostSince(user: Principal, since: bigint) that calls actor.hasNewPostSince(user, since) and returns a boolean. Both hooks should be enabled only when the actor is available and the user is authenticated. Follow the existing query hook patterns in this file.

requirements.summary: Navigate to the latest post when clicking a glowing profile bubble, otherwise navigate to the user's profile page
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a glowing avatar fetches the user's most recent post and navigates to it.
Clicking a non-glowing avatar navigates to that user's profile page.
After clicking a glowing avatar, the glow is cleared for that profile and localStorage is updated with the current timestamp.
If getLatestPostByUser returns null for a glowing profile, fall back to navigating to the user's profile page.

file_operations.description: Update the click handler for profile bubbles to check if the clicked profile is glowing. If glowing, call getLatestPostByUser for that principal and navigate to the post (route: /shortsport with query param ?postId=<postId>). If the backend returns null, fall back to navigating to /user/<principalString>. If not glowing, navigate directly to /user/<principalString>. After clicking a glowing profile, update localStorage key 'lastSeen_<principal>' with the current timestamp (Date.now()) and remove the glow from local state. Use TanStack Router's useNavigate hook for navigation.

Add a new React Query hook useGetLatestPostByUser(user: Principal) that calls actor.getLatestPostByUser(user) and returns a Post or null. Enable the query only when the actor is available. Follow the existing query hook patterns in this file.

requirements.summary: Automatically record profile visits when navigating to UserProfilePage
acceptanceCriteria: recordVisit is called with the viewed user's principal each time UserProfilePage mounts for a profile that is not the authenticated user's own.
The call is fire-and-forget and does not block rendering of the profile page.
Visiting the same profile twice in a row does not create duplicate entries in visit history.

file_operations.description: Add a useEffect hook that runs when the component mounts and whenever the viewed user's principal changes. Inside the effect, check if the viewed principal differs from the authenticated user's principal (using useInternetIdentity().identity?.getPrincipal()). If different, call actor.recordVisit(viewedPrincipal) asynchronously without awaiting the result. Wrap the call in a try-catch to silently handle any errors. Ensure the effect does not block page rendering or data fetching.
